changelog:
@Announcements Ping Retro Rewind v6.13.5 has been released! This hotfix IS required to continue to play online! 

# 🐜 Changelog 🐜
```- The VR login cap is now based on #1 on the leaderboard's VR.``
- Remade the custom items menu and page, including an option to disable all items.
- Removed the Low VR gain nerf for high VR players for non Retro Worldwide modes.
- Modified Online TT to use retro worldwide tracks, rules, and physics.
- Modified the button colors to readd the button animations.
- Added custom character skins to the Discord RPC. Thanks to Darth for making this.
- Added the ability for custom characters to be displayed during spectating. Thanks to Darth for making this.
- Fixed multiple issues with the patches system.
- Cleaned up and optimized a bunch of code.```

As always, please report any and all bugs to the bug reports channel!
Full Download: https://update.rwfc.net/RetroRewind/zip/RetroRewind.zip

Note: I wasn't going to put out another hotfix, but the last VR event was getting people pretty close to the VR login cap I had in place (the cap so that people couldnt just hack to a million vr and go online lol), so I am releasing this hotfix basically exlcusively because of that! Nonetheless, there are 1 or 2 decent sized modifications in this hotfix, so that is something i suppose!
